scope: 本轮只验证算法正确性、Attention Output 近似质量、交互建模的可辨识收益及 held-out 泛化。不要求高效 Sparse Kernel、GPU 延迟、端到端吞吐／加速、完整视频生成质量或 Backbone 共训练。所有最终误差均对选中原始历史 KV + 全部可见当前段 KV所得到的真实 Hard Mask Attention Output评估。真实 Dense/Block Statistics只能用于离线监督或上界诊断，不能进入可部署 Router 的评分。
partition: raw historical tensor row order, contiguous64, fixed original token row IDs; final partial page retained
precision: FP32 raw QK/prototype matching/exact mask output/scorer/loss, TF32 disabled. FP64 normalized mass/residual geometry and O(QBd) retained/exclusive sums and finite-gain intermediates; exported scorer features and masks FP32. This targeted numerical correction prevents cancellation divided by tiny retained mass.

hook.visibility: Captured streaming attention call has no options: all passed historical and entire current chunk are visible; block-causal, not token-causal. Explicit all-true masks reconstructed after audited hook/source checks.

phase0.mask_gradient_guard: Exact logspace forward; mask derivative exp(Lb-Lselected) capped at exp30 ONLY for unrepresentable extreme derivative, counts reported; normal-range gradcheck and direct-gather tests required.

teacher.selection: Full Val group-macro E, tie lower coefficient; never Test
teacher.T3: T2+beta*tanh(asinh(finite add/remove gain/(initial set error+1e-12))); exactly one repack
teacher.train_evaluation: Fixed metadata monitor training cells; full Val for selection; independent Test only after all architecture/checkpoint locks
teacher.headroom_gate: T3 full-Val group-macro relative improvement>=0.5%, positive paired improvements in>=half groups; otherwise stop full R4 correction branch after exact fixed-query local-swap diagnosis, continue sketch/base/local controls and report a negative result

sketch_loss: Train-initial measured inverse scales for Z(mean logZ squared),V(mean mass*valueL2 squared),O(mean query relative dense error); one fixed normalization scheme for all variants/seeds; Val checkpoint by estimated dense global error, no Test tuning.
sketch_initial_scaling: Per seed S4 on36 metadata-fixed Train snapshot tiles, all4steps; save all raw initial scales and weights. Weights reciprocal max(scale,1e-8), normalize to sum3, clip individual normalized weights at100; reuse exactly across variants.
sufficient_gate: S4 full-Val dense estimate global error lower than S1 in>=2/3 seeds AND macro logZ RMSE lower AND majority36 pairs dense error improved. If fail, train S2/S4-var/S4-K plus already-S8; do not enlarge downstream network.

model.assignment: Independent per-pair linear256->P (S4-K reads128 K only); same soft assignment aggregates K and V. S1 exact uniform mean, zero learned assignment parameters.
model.scorer: 8 scalar features ->32->1 PairMLP(shared base+rank1 pair residual), gamma36 independent initialized1; small nonzero residual calibration.
model.local_and_set: Exactly identical4->16->1 PairMLP plus nonnegative softplus alpha per pair(initial0.1). Local first feature log singleton error; set first feature asinh(g/(E0+eps)); same remaining log m/log cost/rho. Local receives no M0,D,z,g.
model.initial_gate: Frozen staged base: detach M0. Joint/scratch: M0 hard+budget STE, final gate same STE. tau=.2,64-step threshold bisection and exact implicit cost-aware derivative.

mass_caveat: R1 uses only predicted mass from SAME Joint-KV S4; its assignment still reads V, so not strictly V-free. S4-K R1-K is a separate strict K-only routing diagnostic when secondary sketch is trained.
comparisons: R3/R3-local/R4 exact same selected S4 AND exact same trained R3 base; frozen digests checked. Independently select correction checkpoints. R4-shuffle frozen intervention mismatches initial masks across query rows within a tile, final budget unchanged.
exposure: Every train snapshot visits8 tiles by min8000x4 draws. Save selected and final exposure separately; maximum does not prove convergence.
optimizer: AdamW lr1e-4,wd.01,warmup+cosine to5%,clip1; corrections independent loss sum and separate clipping, no shared trainable base; full3 seeds.
selection: Fixed36 balanced Val snapshots x4 steps x8 tiles for checkpoint selection; Full864 Val for structure gates. 3-seed independent Test evaluated once only after final model registry locked.
test_policy: User permits reuse if raw data feasible. Reuse existing Train/Val; exposed old Test is excluded from new independent-Test claims. Final independent Test remains disabled without new reserved prompts; main Train/Val experiments proceed.
group_statistics: Micro SSE/energy AND macro mean of within(prompt,generation seed) pooled ratios; group median,P25,P75; fixed-seed paired group bootstrap2000 repetitions; query/tile tails; layer/head prompt seed step history slices; query masks not independent significance units.
extensions: Secondary configs: S2/S4-var/S4-K when S4 insufficient; page-size128, R6 joint and scratch have separate explicit training modes and are not automatically pooled with main controls. R0-P0 and chunk-local Feature Packing are deferred until core results; not claimed completed by the main run.
execution: Prioritizev0.7; v0.6 dispatcher paused by user request, current children finish. Two GPUs exclusive, wait if busy; no proxy variables, HF offline. Phase0 fail stops downstream; immutable source plan and fail-closed jobs.
correction_gate: Train R4 only if both teacher one-pass headroom and S4 sufficiency gates pass; otherwise train equal-capacity R3-local control and report why the interaction branch stopped.

numeric_fix.reason: Phase0 pair L4H1 failed original FP32 omitted-residual accumulation when current/retained mass is small; no model training had begun.
numeric_fix.implementation: D=z*estimatedDense-retainedNumerator; exclusive prefix/suffix sums avoid z-m_b cancellation; FP64 geometry/reductions, FP32 main matrices/features/output. Removal retains (M_b-1) term to preserve original initial-mask STE derivative.
numeric_fix.threshold: Original atol=rtol=5e-5 unchanged; stable complement AND independently summed FP64 omitted residual both checked against raw KV output.
